crossRefs.note: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and strike me and…
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have…
by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers…

translations.web: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.
translations.bsb: In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise,
translations.kjv: In God will I praise his word: in the LORD will I praise his word.
translations.asv: In God (I will praise his word), In Jehovah (I will praise his word),
